LanguageData.PhobosWaterDrop_GizmoDesc: Click a fire within {CELLS} cells. The helicopter flies to the nearest open water, fills its fire bucket, empties it over the fire and comes back to where it stands. Today the bucket carries {LITRES} litres.
LanguageData.PhobosWaterDrop_FliesItself: {HELICOPTER} cannot fly water drop runs: its crew fly it across the map by hand, and a drop needs a planned run.
LanguageData.PhobosWaterDrop_NoBucket: It has no fire bucket aboard. Load one, made at the vehicle parts bench.
LanguageData.PhobosWaterDrop_HasLoad: {LOAD} is on the hook. Set it down or leave it first.
LanguageData.PhobosWaterDrop_NotHere: It has to be standing on this map.
LanguageData.PhobosWaterDrop_Moving: It has to stand still first.
LanguageData.PhobosWaterDrop_NoCrew: It needs its crew aboard and able to fly.
LanguageData.PhobosWaterDrop_Roofed: It cannot take off from under a roof.
LanguageData.PhobosWaterDrop_TooFar: That is too far: a fire within {CELLS} cells.
LanguageData.PhobosWaterDrop_TargetRoofed: Water dropped from the air cannot reach under a roof.
LanguageData.PhobosWaterDrop_NothingBurning: Nothing is burning there under open sky.
LanguageData.PhobosWaterDrop_NoWater: There is no open water within {CELLS} cells to fill the bucket from.
LanguageData.PhobosWaterDrop_NotEnoughFuel: It has too little fuel for the flight there and back.
LanguageData.PhobosWaterDrop_Started: {HELICOPTER} is off to fill its bucket with {LITRES} litres of water.
LanguageData.PhobosWaterDrop_Back: {HELICOPTER} is back down. Its water put out {COUNT} fires.
LanguageData.PhobosWaterDrop_StagePour: Emptying the bucket over the fire
